title: Model in the archived notebook
text: The archived notebook configures BioMistral/BioMistral-7B with BitsAndBytes NF4 quantization. The free local source explorer does not load that model and does not generate clinical answers.
source: LLM Server.ipynb — model configuration; app.py — local demo

title: Retrieval in the research notebook
text: The notebook uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings and a FAISS IndexIVFFlat index. The lightweight local demo uses a deterministic TF-IDF cosine baseline and returns matching source excerpts with their record IDs.
source: LLM Server.ipynb — embedder/index cells; app.py — Retriever

title: What this checkout can establish
text: No trained LoRA adapter, medical evaluation dataset, deployment benchmark, or GPU memory measurements are included in this checkout. The local demo can establish retrieval and API behavior on explicit project notes; it cannot establish hallucination reduction, clinical quality, or production latency.
source: Repository artifact inventory and local demo scope

title: Free local demo requirements
text: The local source explorer runs with Python and Flask. It does not require an API key, Hugging Face token, GPU, ngrok tunnel, or external model download. No credentials are renewed and no paid services are called.
